systems.system: Integrated Civil Registration and Vital Statistics and ID Management System
systems.country_label: Integrated Civil Registration and Vital Statistics and ID Management System

systems.owner: National Civil Registration Authority; Ministry of Health

note: No fact: the plan (January 2024) names the integrated system only as an ongoing project in its project list, without saying what it does, so it cannot be classed. For the parent: the same passage states that under the 2019-2023 plan NCRA completed the UN-guided Comprehensive Country Assessment, developed a costed National CRVS & ID Management Strategic Plan, 'strengthened' birth and death registration and interoperability with the health ministry, and printed securitised birth and death certificates; the project list also carries rehabilitation of district offices and of the NCRA complex.
